title: Story Bible — dramaturgy gate artifact (born 2026-07-03, «Մոռացողը» review)
description: A serial/film production cannot advance past the script stage without this artifact. Enforces the lesson: the secret must be fully written for the AUTHOR before it is fragmented into episodes; the controlling idea must have a real carrier on BOTH sides; every POV character must pay a price. Prose rules do not execute — this schema does.

side_b_carrier.description: The CHARACTER who embodies the counter-argument.

side_b_tragic_reason.description: Why the carrier is RIGHT to believe it — a declared counter-idea without a defensible reason is a strawman, and the gate rejects it.

file.description: Path to the full author-level chronology document (e.g. canon-secret.md).

what_happened.description: The originating event, written plainly, no gaps.

why_silent.description: Why the truth stayed buried all these years.

why_now.description: Why the story detonates NOW and not any other year.

who_knows_what_complete.description: Author confirms every named character has an explicit knows / wrongly-believes entry.

wrongly_believes.description: Every character carries at least one wrong belief — a character with perfect information is a plot device.

cost.description: What pursuing/keeping the secret costs THIS character personally. 'nothing' does not validate.

absorbed.description: Author confirms the era decision has been pushed UPSTREAM through premise, dialogue idiom, character logic and backstory — not just the look bible.
